_comment: English names per element, keyed by the deck's Danish slide title (a whole-slide element) or part name (a shape on a collection slide). The deck stays the authoring surface and its Danish titles are the keys; this file is what a locale adds. A key with no entry fails the harvest. Categories are the heading slides and, for a collection slide, its title.
